MOZ.note: States no authentication, e-signature or digital ID service; it reports document fees.
States nothing on records passing between the civil register and the ID system.
Says only that the service's platform shows fees; it does not state that services can be applied for or completed online.
Gives no count or share of people holding a national ID.
States nothing on an ID number given at birth.
States nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.
States nothing on public registers keyed on the ID number.
Reports fees for ID card renewal at the Centro Pronto; the ID system's issuance, biometrics or security are not described.
